runtime.note: Observed on the ZGX Fury 2026-10-17 (#137): ZRT 0.43.0 (snap revision x6) wraps vLLM 0.30.0 (torch 2.13.0+cu130), the same requirements digest as the Nano (c61e5b48...). The proxy listens on 127.0.0.1:8080 with auth type none. Starting a model needs the installed CUDA 13.2 toolchain first on PATH (infra/fury/zrt/serve-model.sh); the distribution's CUDA 12.0 nvcc cannot build sm_103a kernels.

model.artifact_digest_method: sha256 over sorted 'path sha256' lines of all 144 files at the revision, computed on the Fury (2026-10-18, #141); all 133 LFS files matched the Hugging Face LFS sha256 for that revision
model.architecture: Qwen4ExpForConditionalGeneration (125B total, 6B active MoE, plus 51B n-gram embedding offloaded to CPU memory and 4B MTP); served text-only
model.quantization: fp8 e4m3, weight blocks 128x128, dynamic activations (943 modules kept in higher precision)
model.license_review: Accepted by the maintainer, 2026-10-17 (#137): "yes, i accept the qwen-community-1.0 licence for Qwen3.8-Flash-Next"

generation.prompt_source: apps/api/app/modules/guidance/local.py: guidance-local-5 (#550, #551) is guidance-local-4 with two wording changes: rule 5 asks case-fact claims to report what the person said ("You reported ..."), never "You have ..." (the self-care first draft was always rejected for it and needed the repair), and rule 9 keeps drafts shorter (at most 4 claims, 1 to 2 clinical, 2 to 3 clinician questions, one short sentence each); encoding short-ids-2 leaves evidence_ids out of the model's schema when no evidence is supplied. Not re-qualified (ADR-019); measured in evidence/clinical-review/2026-10-26-selfcare-speed/. Previous: guidance-local-4, sha256 91cd723e89696ba2fbd6081d51500fe2ee3355db5b8eeacc5182339df9a704ab (2026-10-19 to 2026-10-26): guidance-local-4 (#179, ADR-015 amendment 3) is guidance-local-3 plus rule 10, 'Address the person as "you".', with the third_person validator check. Re-qualified under ADR-002 on both devices on 2026-10-19 with encoding short-ids-1 (evidence/model-qualification/2026-10-19-guidance-local-4/README.md). Previous: guidance-local-3, sha256 a0fdadb53f9c50fcdd053a57867bfa09201e94beaaa64d9e58f9b0b439560a70 (2026-10-16 to 2026-10-19).

generation.encoding_source: apps/api/app/modules/guidance/local.py ENCODING_VERSION (#199): confirmed facts and evidence reach the model as short aliases (F1, E1) that are mapped back to their UUIDs before validation; the instructions are unchanged.

application_policy.retry_after_note: Proposed positive initial delay, not a measured completion estimate; clients must still handle continued saturation.
application_policy.retrieval_note: Initial master-document limits for local mode; verify total input plus output against the selected model context before local mode. Mock simulation uses its synthetic fixture pack and does not require a clinically reviewed corpus or pathway package.

validation.note: Verified by the ADR-002 qualification harness on the ZGX Fury (#137), outside the app, plus the ADR-015 explanation check through the app API in local mode. deletion_and_revision_guards_passed and warm_rehearsal_completed stay false until verified on this device. no_cloud_egress_verified is per-second socket sampling, not a packet capture.

local_mode_gate: Block local routine guidance until the app's local path (#51) is verified and an enabled reviewed pathway (ADR-003) and approved corpus (ADR-004) exist. Never substitute fixture output or a cloud response for a failed local request.

qualification.selection: ADR-018: the only model that passed every unrelaxed ADR-002 gate on the Fury; the Qwen3.6-35B-A3B-FP8 control failed stage 2 there (59/69 after one repair) with both kernel configurations. The maintainer delegated the choice ("decide model by yourself", 2026-10-18), so the blinded clinical grading (evidence/clinical-review/2026-10-17-fury-explanations/) is not a precondition; explanations stay labeled as not clinically reviewed.

environment.VLLM_HOST_IP: 127.0.0.1 (#151: vLLM's own sockets stay on loopback; unset, it used the default route's address)
environment.GLOO_SOCKET_IFNAME: lo (#176: the CPU process group binds to loopback; VLLM_HOST_IP does not cover it, and the Fury's hostname also resolves to its external address)
environment.VLLM_NO_USAGE_STATS: 1 (#175: vLLM usage statistics off; unset, a report goes to https://stats.vllm.ai at start and every 10 minutes)
environment.HF_HUB_OFFLINE: 1 (#175: the model loads from a local path)
